headline: United Capital Pre-Tax Profit Increases 66% on Surge in Investment Income
summary: Nigerian financial services group United Capital Plc reported a 66.24% surge in pre-tax profit to 41.58 billion naira for the first nine months of 2026, driven by nearly doubled investment income.
why: United Capital is a prominent West African investment banking and asset management group listed on the Nigerian Exchange.

impacts.name: United Capital Plc
impacts.why: Doubling of investment portfolio income accelerates net profitability growth.
